facts.text: Gross farm receipts in Norfolk County totalled $519 million, up 43% compared with five years earlier.

facts.text: Norfolk County has the most farms in Ontario reporting over $2 million in income, and its farmers employ 6,493 seasonal workers.
facts.evidence: Norfolk County has the most farms in Ontario reporting over $2 million in income, and their farmers employ more workers than anywhere else in Canada: 6,493 seasonal workers, 812 full-time and 314 part-time.

facts.text: Agriculture is Norfolk County's second-largest industry sector after manufacturing, measured by export values.
facts.evidence: Agriculture is Norfolk County's second largest industry sector after manufacturing, in terms of export values.

facts.text: Norfolk County has six wineries and eight breweries, along with live theatre, eco-adventure activities and farm stores.
facts.evidence: Norfolk County now has six wineries and eight breweries, live theater, eco-adventure activities plus all kinds of farm stores and roadside markets.

facts.text: Norfolk County Economic Development is the official destination marketing authority for Simcoe, Port Dover, Delhi, Waterford and Port Rowan.
facts.evidence: The office is the official destination marketing authority for Norfolk County and its various population centres: Simcoe, Port Dover, Delhi, Waterford, and Port Rowan.

meta.descriptor: a rural county on the north shore of Lake Erie, centred on the town of Simcoe
meta.fact: home to more Ontario farms reporting over $2 million in income than anywhere else in the province

overview: Norfolk County had 67,490 residents in 2021, up 5.4% from 64,044 in 2016, in 27,594 occupied private dwellings spread over 1,597.7 square kilometres. That is a large rural area with several small towns rather than one dominant centre, so customers may live a long drive from your door.
Farming is central to the local economy, and Lake Erie beaches, wineries and breweries bring seasonal visitors. Businesses here serve both year-round residents and a summer surge of tourists.

byService.lead-generation: Norfolk County lead generation should plan for two audiences: steady year-round residents and the summer visitors who arrive for Port Dover and the Lake Erie shoreline.
byService.seo: With customers spread across Simcoe, Delhi, Waterford and the lakeshore, SEO should target each town by name and capture tourist searches such as things to do nearby.
byService.website-development: Across 1,597.7 square kilometres, a Norfolk County website should list hours, seasonal changes and directions clearly, because many visitors plan the trip on their phone.
byService.branding: Branding in Norfolk County can lean on farm-fresh, small-town and lakeside character, which local residents and visiting tourists both recognize and trust.
